skeleton.audio: D:/工作文件/2025年/物料动效/Olympians消消乐动效/image/scatter

Symbols pay anywhere on the screen, The total number of the same symbol on the screen at the end of a spin determines the value of the win.
This is the SCATTER symbol.SCATTER symbol is present on all reels.

The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols disappear.
The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with symbols coming from above.
Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.There's no limit to the numble of possible tumbles.
All wins are added to the player's balance after all of the tumbles resuited from a base spin have been played.

These are the multiplier symbols, They are present on all reels and can hit randomly during spins and tumbles in both base game and FREE SPINS.Whenever a MULTIPLIER symbol hits, it takes a random muitiplier value from 2x to 1000x.
Possible values are: 2x,3x,4x,5x,6x,8x,10x,12x,15x,20x,25x,50x,100x,250x,500x or 1000x.
When the tumbling sequence ends,the values of all MULTIPLIER symbols on the screen are added together and the total win of the sequence is multiplied by the final value.

The FREE SPINS FEATURE is awarded when 3 or more SCATTER symbols hit anywhere on the screen.
The round starts with 10 free spins.
During the Free Spins round, whenever a multiplier symbol appears and the spin results in a win, the muitiplier value is added to the total multiplier.
Throughout the entire round, if any new multiplier symbol appears and the spin results in a win, the total multiplier will also be applied to the winnings.If 3 or more SCATTER symbols appear during the Free Spins round, 5 additional free spins will be awarded.
Special reels are active during the Free Spins round.

2x Bet: Increases the chance of triggering Free Spins by increasing the appearance of scatter symbols on the reels.
100x Bet: Instantly triggers the Free Spins feature through apurchased round.
Press and hold the SPIN button to select the number of consecutive auto-spins in the pop-up window.
Activate EX Mode ,costing an additional 100%,with a higher chance of triggering the feature
